items.label: Largest import file (MB)
items.description: A larger CSV or XLSX file is not imported.
items.long_description: An XLSX also may not unpack to more than 256 MB. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Most rows in an import
items.description: A file with more rows is refused.
items.long_description: Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Import batch size
items.description: Rows applied between two saves of an import's progress.
items.long_description: 1 to 5000. A restarted import carries on from the last saved batch. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Require a clean dry run before an import
items.description: A real import needs a dry run of the same file, without errors, in the last day.
items.long_description: Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Most records in an export
items.description: An export that matches more records is refused; narrow the filter.
items.long_description: Organizations can override the global default.
